senses.gloss: to split, divide off. Denom. (cmp. מְחִיצָה) פָּרוֹכֶת.

units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>באחרונה אדם פּוֹרְכוֹ בידו וכ׳</he> at last (when silver has been worked over several times) one may crumble it in one’s hand, and it is no longer fit for any work.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 89b">B. Mets. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>יִפְרוֹךְ</he> Ms. R., v. infra; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>פָּרוּךְ</he>; pl. <he>פְּרוּכִים</he>, <he>פְּרוּכִין</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 10-13</cite> (ref. to <he>אמילם</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:10">ib.</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01590"><he>מָלַל</he></cite>) <he>והמה פ׳</he> and they were (shall be) crushed.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 39">Yalk. Gen. 39</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00923"><he>פָּכַר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to crush, grind; to crack; to husk.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 75b:7">Men. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>מְפָרְכָן עד וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Berakhot 37b:7">Ber. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>פּוֹרְכָן</he>) he crushes them until he has reduced them to the fineness of the flour of which they had been made.
<cite ref="Beitzah 12b:14">Bets. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מְפָרְכִין קטניות וכ׳</he> you may husk peas on the Holy Day.

<cite ref="Shabbat 53b:5">Sabb. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>סכין ומפרכין לאדם וכ׳</he> Ar. a. early eds. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70; ed. a. Mss. <he>מפרכסין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01862"><he>פִּרְכֵּס</he> I</cite>) you may oint a sore and scrape the scab off for a human being (on the Sabbath), but not for a beast; a. e.—[Ib. 155ᵇ <he>מפרכין תבן</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01846"><he>פְּרַךְ</he> II</cite>.]

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 89b:3">B. Mets. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יַפְרִיךְ … מַפְרִיךְ וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. <he>יִפְרוֹךְ</he>) the laborer must not smash fruits against a rock and eat them, but he may smash them one by one (with his hand) and eat; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130">Yalk. Gen. 130</cite> <he>מפריכין</he>, read: <he>מפרינין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01879"><he>פָּרַן</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be crumbled; to be cracked; to be scraped, peeled.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 37b:8">Bekh. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>יבישה כדי שתהא נִפְרֶכֶת</he> a sore is called dry, when it can be scraped.
<cite ref="Chullin 46b:8">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שתִּיפָּרֵךְ וכ׳</he> that it can be scraped off with the nail.
<cite ref="Berakhot 25a:20">Ber. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כל זמן שזורקה ואינה נפרכת</he> when he throws it down, and it is not crumbled.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>שנִיפְרָךְ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01847"><he>פֶּרֶךְ</he></cite>; a. e.
